description: For infinite X, q_X(n) belongs to X, exceeds n, and is at most every member of X exceeding n.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.nextPoint_spec (X : Set ℕ) (hX : X.Infinite) (n : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.nextPoint X n ∈ X ∧
    n < Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.nextPoint X n ∧
      ∀ m ∈ X, n < m → Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.nextPoint X n ≤ m
